body:
S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term. This shows that investors over time have bought the index at higher prices and indicates good development for the market. The index is approacing resistance at 7600 points, which may give a negative reaction. However, a break upwards through 7600 points will be a positive signal. The RSI curve shows a rising trend, which supports the positive trend.
